# Council approves transport plan

*London, Sept. 24, 2026* — After 3 days of talks, the council approved a £1.2bn plan (see [the report](https://example.gov.uk/report.pdf)).

## Key figures

- 40 km of new cycle lanes by 2028
- Night buses up 30%, from 11:30 p.m. to 5 a.m.
- Fares frozen at £2.50 until 31/03/2027

| Line | Frequency | Cost |
|------|-----------|------|
| N29 | every 12 min | £1.75 |

Dr. Jane O'Brien, the council's transport lead, said: "It's the 1st step, not the last."
